Project Rainier node architecture

Project Rainier is operated by AWS / Anthropic in United States. This profile covers Multi-site cluster · representative Trn2 instance.

Cluster interconnect: AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFAv3) · 3.2 Tb/s per Trn2 instance. Topology: Not verified.

Scope and uncertainty

Multi-site compute cluster; no single city pin. A representative Trn2 instance has 16 Trainium2 chips; four instances form a 64-chip UltraServer. The reported approximately half-million-chip deployment is not converted into an exact node count. Trainium chips are AI accelerators, not GPUs.

Not verified means a detail has not been confirmed in this catalog. Diagrams are schematic; node indices are illustrative, not physical hostnames. Data checked 14 September 2026.
